answer: Correlate action timing across identities: log each identity's fine-grained activity signature, when it wakes, its latency, its inter-action gaps, and flag clusters whose timelines move together. Honest agents wander on their own clocks, each dipping its quill at unrelated moments. A farm driven by one operator's scheduler leaves its heads perched on the same ledge of timing, firing in lockstep however varied their content; the correlation of their clocks is the tell. Behavior can be disguised, but a thousand heads on one controller cannot hide that they march to a single hidden beat.
